prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE complete, flat, opaque SNS poster in landscape 16:9, with editorial color nursery photography and precise Korean typography. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

The supplied image is a newly authored planning diagram for image mass, actual-copy clearance, reading relationships and mature type anatomy. Interpret it into real color photography. Its gray shapes are placeholders for plants, pots, a supporting hand and photographic details; do not reproduce gray shapes, blobs, pale generic illustration or the sketch's neutral appearance. Its coordinates and 1600×900 size are flexible planning choices, not a final pixel requirement. All lettering in the finished poster must be generated as part of this single image.

Whole visual design: a substantial photographic L wraps the reading entrance. The left roughly 35% is a full-height, close oblique encounter at a working nursery bench, cropped to fill the edge: multiple living houseplants attached to convincing stems in small terracotta and ceramic pots, visible soil and pot rims, and one older, larger established plant receding behind. A grower's natural cropped forearm enters from the left to cradle and present one small planted pot; the palm supports the base, the fingers have clear ownership and the pot is visibly supported, inviting the viewer to choose it. Keep the scene tactile, specific and abundant, not empty-room decor. Along the upper right, broad unequal photographic crops of attached leaf/stem, pot rim and gritty soil extend the same nursery experience at a much closer distance. These are a strong image edit spanning the top, with unequal widths and restrained narrow gutters, not three equal decorative thumbnails. The left scene and upper detail edit together organize the whole poster and open the wide right reading area.

Use cool natural green leaves, nuanced earthen pottery, honest soft greenhouse daylight and crisp contact surfaces. Photographic crops are flush, rectangular and purposeful. The type area is a clear light warm-white planar editorial surface opened by the L, with deep green-black text and no ornamental pattern. Let real image scale, crop and contact carry the feeling of selecting and caring for a living plant.

Typography and route: directly below the upper detail crop, place the smaller semibold market eyebrow, then the Korean Title as the immediately recognizable dominant verbal anchor. The Title is a generous mature Korean serif with open counters, stable squared syllable construction and controlled stroke contrast, substantially larger than all other copy. Use the guide's mature serif anatomy as a reference, not as a claim that a font file is applied. Quiet English companion immediately below. One compatible Korean medium sans reading system supplies subtitle, body and practical rows; the subtitle and eyebrow alone may be semibold. Ordinary proportional Latin and numerals, stable baseline, balanced Korean counters and generous meaningful word spaces. All type is flat, crisp and free of photographic texture, perspective, strokes or shadows.

The subtitle leads directly to the broad body paragraph at the same left optical axis. Keep the body large enough to read comfortably at a 720px-wide display (roughly 17–18px apparent body size), in the three meaningful soft lines supplied below with ordinary leading. After a short clear gap, descend into locally paired practical rows: date with hours; venue with access; care line; invitation with URL. These are continuous useful reading from the body, not isolated corner labels or a tiny footer. Practical text remains medium and comfortably readable at 720px; title stays dominant, English quieter. Maintain clear bottom and right clearance, no leaf/stem/edge/divider/shadow inside or immediately alongside glyphs.

Print only the following exact copy, each entry once. Role labels and quotation marks are instructions and must not print. Preserve every word space, Hangul syllable, Latin case, ampersand, period, comma, colon, en dash and middle dot.
Market eyebrow: "성수 주말 식물 마켓"
Korean Title: "집 안의 작은 숲"
English companion: "LEAVES & LIVING"
Subtitle: "초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다."
Body paragraph, these three soft lines:
"작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다.
재배자의 이야기를 듣고,
우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요."
Date: "2027.06.12–06.13"
Hours: "토·일 11:00–19:00"
Venue: "성수 온실마당"
Access: "입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연"
Care: "식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공"
Invitation: "편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요."
URL: "leaves.example/market"

No extra print, heading, bullet, pipe, arrow, plant tag, price, logo, watermark or QR. Keep range marks as clearly distinguishable en dashes, not short hyphens; preserve dots and colons. Do not separate words in the URL. Single finished poster, no mockup, frame, comparison sheet or multiple poster panels. No character clipart, clay/toy package, generic huge-object/title/tiny-footer scaffold or passive black/gray information field. Exclude passive solid, near-solid or split-color headline/date/information templates with subordinate little images, texture-only or font-only substitutions, and empty-room dressing of those templates. The substantial close nursery encounter and unequal photo editing must actively organize this complete composition.
